_comment: Codex scene data (js/scenes/codexScene.js): Earthbound dossiers for the hero classes (the class mentors, Act III) and the summons that are not familiars. Familiar summons take their name and text from js/skills.js.

catalyst.en: Called by the Pentagram Seal to the heart of the star.
catalyst.fil: Tinawag ng Pentagram Seal sa puso ng bituin.

lore.en: The sixth soul of the Pentagram Prophecy, summoned as a Novice. At Lv 10 the Imperial Citadel's dais awakens one of five callings.
lore.fil: Ang ikaanim na kaluluwa ng Propesiya ng Pentagram, tinawag bilang Novice. Sa Lv 10, gigisingin ng dais ng Imperial Citadel ang isa sa limang tungkulin.

earthRole.fil: Superbisor ng Demolisyon at Site Engineer

catalyst.en: Crushed while shielding a rookie from falling steel beams.
catalyst.fil: Nadaganan habang sinasangga ang isang baguhan mula sa nahuhulog na bakal.

lore.en: Used to hauling steel and protecting his crew. His engineer's mind became a Bastion Forcefield that nothing can break.
lore.fil: Sanay sa pagbuhat ng bakal at pagprotekta sa tauhan. Ang kanyang pagka-engineer ay naging Bastion Forcefield na walang kayang tumibag.

earthRole.fil: Biyologo ng Kalikasan at Olympic Archer

catalyst.en: Froze in a blizzard while sheltering an injured alpine falcon.
catalyst.fil: Nanigas sa bagyong niyebe habang kinakanlong ang sugatang alpine falcon.

lore.en: A quiet guardian of the woods, reborn in an elven body together with the soul of the alpine falcon she sheltered.
lore.fil: Tahimik na tagapagtanggol ng kakahuyan. Muling nabuhay sa katawan ng Elf kasama ang kaluluwa ng alpine falcon na kanyang kinanlong.

catalyst.en: Heart failure after a grueling 36-hour surgical triage shift.
catalyst.fil: Atake sa puso matapos ang 36 na oras na triage sa operasyon.

lore.en: A doctor who swore no patient would die in front of him. His triage became Holy Magic.
lore.fil: Isang doktor na sumumpang walang pasyenteng mamamatay sa kanyang harapan. Ang kanyang triage ay naging Banal na Salamangka.

earthRole.fil: Astropisiko at Analyst ng Satellite Radar

catalyst.en: Enveloped by an anomalous cosmic gamma pulse during a sky scan.
catalyst.fil: Nabalot ng kakaibang cosmic gamma pulse habang sinusuri ang langit.

lore.en: She knows celestial mechanics and orbital trajectories by heart. Her old meteor equations became the burning Meteor Fall.
lore.fil: Kabisado ang celestial mechanics at orbital trajectories. Ang dating equations ng mga bulalakaw ay naging nagliliyab na Meteor Fall.

catalyst.en: Killed defending a helpless pedestrian from armed robbers.
catalyst.fil: Napatay habang ipinagtatanggol ang isang walang-laban na naglalakad mula sa armadong holdaper.

lore.en: Raised on rough streets where fists were the only shield. He brought that discipline across to prove a punch can crush a monster.
lore.fil: Lumaki sa magulong lansangan kung saan tanging kamao ang panangga. Dinala ang kanyang disiplina upang patunayang kayang durugin ng suntok ang halimaw.

desc.en: The falcon Lyra sheltered in the blizzard, crossed over with her soul. It hovers at the Archer's shoulder and dives on marked foes (Falcon Dive, K).
desc.fil: Ang falcon na kinanlong ni Lyra sa bagyong niyebe, tumawid kasama ng kanyang kaluluwa. Lumilipad ito sa balikat ng Archer at sumisisid sa minarkahang kalaban (Falcon Dive, K).

desc.en: Winged wardens of Astraea called by the Priest's prayer (K). They strike nearby foes and fade after a while; healing extends their stay.
desc.fil: Mga may-pakpak na bantay ni Astraea na tinawag ng panalangin ng Priest (K). Tinatamaan nila ang kalapit na kalaban at naglalaho pagkaraan; pinahahaba ng paggaling ang kanilang pananatili.
